description.narrative: Since its inception in 2012, the Umbrella Facility for Gender Equality (UFGE) is the only World Bank (WB) multidonor trust fund, dedicated solely to strengthening knowledge and evidence for transformative gender solutions. It is therefore very much in alignment with A Better World. UFGE’s portfolio spans 239 projects in 101 low- and middle income countries, including 60 International Development Association (IDA)-eligible countries and 29 Fragile and Conflict-Affected Situations (FCS) countries, with a clear mission to accelerate gender equality. A significant goal of the UFGE is to provide WB teams, IFIs and other development partners’ with evidence-based solutions to demonstrate how to advance gender equality as part of country and sector approaches to reducing poverty and boosting shared prosperity. UFGE programme has been extended to June 2030 enabling the programme to leverage the new World Bank Gender Strategy for stronger development outcomes.
